name: Ashla Staff
description: An Ashla Staff was a type of staff, often created from wooden branches gifted by Tholothian dignitaries, used by the Revered Masters of Lasat culture. These staffs held a spiritual purpose in Lasat culture, and had a special connection to the Force. A survivor of the Siege of Lasan named Chava carried one such staff on her journeys to return to Lira San.
